name: Collect a Keycap! [🏮LUNAR EVENT]
desc:
Welcome to Collect a Keycap!

👍 Like the game and join the group for more keycaps!

📢NEW CODE: "FRIDAY"
USE AT THE CODES MENU!

How to play:
🔥 Collect keycaps in the center of the map
⬇️ Place the keycaps on your plot
💸 Generate money
🔄 Rebirth
🛠️ Craft even more valuable keycaps!

💻 Supports all platforms!
